title: WorkForce
description: The perfect way to manage jobs in roleplay servers
body:
# WorkForce is a lightweight yet powerful mod designed for roleplay servers.
**It allows admins to restrict the crafting of certain items based on a player's job.**
- **GUI-Driven**: manage restricted items from an intuitive chest interface.
- **Multi-Job Support**: Players can have multiple jobs at once since the mod relies on Minecraft's tag system.
- **Vanilla Friendly**: No new items or blocks added. Plyers dont even need the mod to play on your server (Cliend-optional)
- **Zero Dependencies**: The mod is standalone and lightweight.


How to configure the mod:
> /profession help - View the full list of available commands.

> /profession list - See all active professions on the server.

> /profession gui - Open the management interface.

> /profession assign <player> <job> - Assign a specific role to a player.

> /profession create <name> Create a new profession.

> /profession delete <name> - Delete a profession and its data.

> /profession list - Show all professions and online workers.

> /profession gui <name> - Open the item configuration GUI.

> /profession assign <player> <name> - Assign a profession to a player.

> /profession fire <player> <name> - Remove a profession from a player.
